name: Ubuntu Quick Start
description: A single plain Ubuntu container for quickly exploring Practicum with no topology to configure.
author: Practicum Team

sections.title: Get Started
sections.content_markdown:
This lab gives you a single Ubuntu 22.04 container to explore. It has no GUI — you interact with it entirely from a shell.

1. Start the lab from Practicum.
2. Find the container:

```
docker ps --filter "name=practicum"
```

3. Open a shell in it:

```
docker exec -it <container-name> bash
```

You now have a full Ubuntu shell to experiment in.

tasks.text: Open a shell in the Ubuntu container with docker exec.
